## Type

- [ ] New translation model
- [ ] New language pair
- [ ] Better default model recommendation
- [ ] Update existing model recommendation

## Model / Language details

- **Name**: (e.g. HY-MT1.5-7B, NLLB-200-3.3B, etc.)
- **Provider / Source**: (e.g. Hugging Face, LM Studio Hub)
- **Link**: (paste a URL)
- **License**: (e.g. Apache 2.0, MIT, CC-BY)
- **Size**: (e.g. 7B params, ~4 GB Q4)
- **Languages supported**: (list)
- **Translation quality**: (your subjective experience / benchmarks if available)

## Why should this be the default / supported?

Explain why this model/language is a good fit for Karpa's privacy-first, local-only philosophy.

## Tested locally?

- [ ] I have tested this model with Karpa
- [ ] Translation quality is acceptable
- [ ] Performance is acceptable on consumer hardware

If tested, briefly describe the experience.

## Additional context

Add any links to documentation, blog posts, or comparison benchmarks.
